## Checklist

- [ ] Checks pass for the side(s) I touched (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-request-conventions)).
- [ ] API change: the docs are updated and `make sync-types` has regenerated the OpenAPI snapshot, the docs-site spec and the frontend types.
- [ ] User-facing change: covered by a test, or an e2e spec where it is a flow.
- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](../CLA.md); the CLA check asks on your first pull request.
